semantics.clock: All sequential logic samples on the positive clock edge, as explicitly required.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset abandons any partial frame and returns to idle; done is cleared on the reset edge.
semantics.frame: An idle sampled zero is the start bit. The following eight positive edges sample data bits 0 through 7. The next positive edge checks the stop bit.
semantics.success: A high expected stop bit asserts done for the cycle immediately following that edge and makes the sampled byte valid. A following low may start the next frame immediately.
semantics.error: A low expected stop bit invalidates the frame. Ignore zeros until a high is sampled, then permit a subsequent zero to start a new frame.
semantics.initialization: No power-up state is specified; verification begins with a synchronous reset. out_byte is checked only when done is one.

numeric.order: Least significant bit first, explicitly stated

verification.oracle: Independent transaction-progress reference driven from the original start/data/stop requirements
verification.sampling: Drive at falling edges; compare after positive-edge sequential updates
verification.cases: Idle, every byte value, consecutive frames, bad stop and delayed recovery, reset at every frame phase, reset synchronization, deterministic pseudorandom stream
verification.completion: Bounded timeout and fatal mismatches; PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities.text: It should assert done each time it finds a stop bit
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Read in context of correctly received bytes: assert only on a high at the expected stop position. A later high after a failed stop resynchronizes without validating the invalid frame.

specification_ambiguities.text: Initial register values and out_byte outside done are unspecified
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Do not assume initial values; reset before checks and ignore out_byte when done is low.
